summary: KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm awards the KTH Scholarship to a small share of its strongest fee-paying master's applicants. It covers the full tuition fee of a one- or two-year master's; for 2026, 65 of 718 admitted applicants (9%) were nominated.
meta_title: KTH Scholarship 2027: full tuition for a master's in Stockholm
meta_description: The KTH Scholarship covers full tuition for a KTH master's. Apply on universityadmissions.se with KTH first, then 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027.
covers: The full tuition fee of a one- or two-year master's programme at KTH.
Year two is covered if your first-year results are satisfactory.
eligibility: Fee-paying students: in Sweden, generally citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland.
KTH must be your first-priority choice on universityadmissions.se, and you must have paid the application fee; programmes ranked second to fourth cannot get the scholarship.

Eligible programmes: all two-year master's at KTH, the joint programmes Molecular Techniques in Life Science and Biostatistics and Data Science, and the one-year Architectural Lighting Design. Joint Erasmus+ and EIT programmes and Computer Simulations for Science and Engineering are not eligible.

Selection rests mainly on academic excellence: grades, the ranking of your bachelor's university, research, publications, work, awards and activities, and your motivation to contribute to the sustainable development goals.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible KTH master's on universityadmissions.se in the first round for autumn 2027 (16 October 2026 to 15 January 2027), with KTH as your first priority, and pay the application fee.
Submit the KTH Scholarship form on KTH's scholarship page between 1 December 2026 and 15 January 2027; no extra documents are needed.
Upload your admission documents to universityadmissions.se by 1 February 2027, since KTH assesses the scholarship from them.
watch_out: Only your first-choice programme counts: list KTH second and you cannot get the scholarship.
It pays tuition only, so budget for living costs in Stockholm.
Competition is stiff: for 2026, 65 of 718 admitted applicants, about 9%, were nominated.

faq.q: Does the KTH Scholarship cover living costs?
faq.a: No. It covers the full tuition fee of your master's, for both years of a two-year programme if your first-year results are satisfactory. You pay your own living costs.

faq.q: When can I apply for the KTH Scholarship for 2027?
faq.a: The scholarship form is open from 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027, and results come on 1 April 2027. You must also apply for your master's on universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027, with KTH as your first choice.
KTH does not set a fixed number. For 2026, 65 of 718 admitted applicants, about 9%, were nominated for the scholarship.
